entries.text: The comment-policy check in CI and `make comment-policy-check` scans only the files that differ from the base, as the hook already did, and the whole repository after a global change: the policy, the cleanup scope policy, the launcher, a trusted checker file (or an unreadable trusted-file list), or a removed exception or exclusion. Files holding an exception are also scanned when the exception's consumer changes. The ratchet, review gating, new files under exclusions, consumer validation and expired-exception findings still run on every pull request. A new `Comment Policy Nightly` workflow scans the whole of develop every night and on demand (`scripts/run_comment_policy.py --full`); when any file has a violation it fails and opens or updates an issue, and a clean run closes it.
